Scenario fixture: a11ycore-video-poster-text-alternative-present (“<video poster> must have a text alternative”)

Each test video has a stable id of the form video_case_XX. These cases focus on poster images (non-text content) and text alternative mechanisms.

A. Baseline (eligible)

01 — FAIL: poster present, no name and no fallback
Poster present; missing accessible name and fallback text.
02 — PASS: poster present, aria-label provides name
Accessible name via aria-label.
03 — PASS: poster present, fallback text provides alternative
Fallback text inside <video>.

B. aria-hidden eligibility behavior

04 — NOT APPLICABLE: aria-hidden and not tabbable
Ineligible (aria-hidden, not tabbable, not IDREF-referenced).
05 — FAIL: aria-hidden but tabbable (tabindex=0), poster present, unnamed
Eligibility override: tabbable focus makes it applicable.

C. Role exclusions (presentation/none)

06 — NOT APPLICABLE: role=presentation and not focusable
Excluded by role when not focusable.
07 — FAIL: role=presentation but focusable (tabindex=0), poster present, unnamed
Focusable overrides role exclusion; still requires a text alternative.

D. Inertness / non-applicability

08 — NOT APPLICABLE: inert ancestor makes video ineligible
Ineligible due to inert ancestor.
09 — NOT APPLICABLE: empty poster attribute
Poster is empty/whitespace; rule does not apply.

End of fixture.
